description: Bornes de recharge pour is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mairie de Boé. List of functional charging points for electric vehicles in Boé. Coverage: Mairie de Boé. The publisher named on the listing is Mairie de Boé. Its keywords include bornes-electriques, bornes-de-recharge, irve, vehicules-electrique, mobilite-transport. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLS, JSON. The listing shows 2021-10-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
